$comment: Maps conversation topics to knowledge base sections in hoopla-domain.md. Used by ContextAssembler to surface relevant domain context based on detected topics in the current conversation. Keys are topic identifiers; values describe the mapping.

per_circulation_revenue.label: Per-Circulation Revenue Model
per_circulation_revenue.coach_note: Trigger push-back if impact claims do not account for per-circulation cost implications.

b2b2c_model.label: B2B2C Business Model
b2b2c_model.coach_note: Ensure both admin and patron audiences are addressed in business cases.

platform_scope.label: Client Platforms
platform_scope.coach_note: Challenge 'all platforms' scope claims. Ask for explicit platform prioritization.

kmp_migration.label: Kotlin Multiplatform Migration
kmp_migration.coach_note: Flag KMP migration risk for Android features touching business logic.

swiftui_migration.label: SwiftUI Migration
swiftui_migration.coach_note: Flag SwiftUI alignment for new iOS features.

accessibility.label: WCAG AA Accessibility
accessibility.coach_note: Flag missing accessibility section in business case. WCAG AA is contractually required.

drm.label: Digital Rights Management
drm.coach_note: Flag DRM complexity as risk when offline access or download features are proposed.

consortia.label: Library Consortia
consortia.coach_note: Clarify whether feature scope is single-library or consortia-level.

content_lifecycle.label: Content Lifecycle
content_lifecycle.coach_note: Ask which lifecycle stage is affected by the proposed feature.

metrics_definitions.label: Key Metrics and Definitions
metrics_definitions.coach_note: Use these definitions to push back on vague metric claims.

coppa.label: COPPA Compliance
coppa.coach_note: COPPA flag is a hard stop. Must be raised immediately when minors are mentioned.

privacy.label: Privacy and Data Compliance
privacy.coach_note: Flag privacy impact when patron data collection or sharing is proposed.

erate.label: E-Rate and CIPA
erate.coach_note: Note E-Rate implications for content filtering features.

content_types.label: Content Catalog Types
content_types.coach_note: Ensure business cases specify which content types are in scope.

admin_controls.label: Library Admin Controls
admin_controls.coach_note: Ensure features that affect borrow rates include admin control mechanisms.

discovery.label: Content Discovery
discovery.section: 12. Common Anti-Patterns in Hoopla Feature Requests
discovery.coach_note: Discovery features drive borrows and have direct per-circulation cost impact. Require cost-impact analysis.

social_features.label: Social and Sharing Features
social_features.section: 12. Common Anti-Patterns in Hoopla Feature Requests
social_features.coach_note: Social features require privacy impact analysis and patron consent flows.

notifications.label: Patron Notifications
notifications.section: 12. Common Anti-Patterns in Hoopla Feature Requests
notifications.coach_note: Notifications require patron consent, platform-specific implementation, and defined success metrics.

recommendation_engine.label: Vague Recommendation Engine Request
recommendation_engine.section: 12. Common Anti-Patterns in Hoopla Feature Requests
recommendation_engine.coach_response: Push back: what discovery gap is this solving? What is the per-circulation cost impact?

improve_search.label: Vague Search Improvement Request
improve_search.section: 12. Common Anti-Patterns in Hoopla Feature Requests
improve_search.coach_response: Push back: what search behavior is failing? For which users? What measurable outcome defines 'improved'?

kids_section.label: Kids or Children's Section
kids_section.section: 12. Common Anti-Patterns in Hoopla Feature Requests
kids_section.coach_response: Immediate COPPA flag. Must be raised before any feature work discussion proceeds.

all_platforms.label: All-Platforms Scope Claim
all_platforms.coach_response: Challenge: which platforms are truly required for launch vs. future? Require explicit platform prioritization.

increase_engagement.label: Engagement as Metric
increase_engagement.section: 12. Common Anti-Patterns in Hoopla Feature Requests
increase_engagement.coach_response: Engagement is not a metric. Define what it means in per-circulation terms. Current baseline? Target?
